content_sections.heading: NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Silchar (An Institute of National Importance)

An experimental and numerical investigation of the mechanical properties of geothermal reservoir rocks and the fluid flow from hot springs in the Tawang region of Arunachal Pradesh, North Eastern India
Dr. Dinesh P, Assistant Professor, Dept. of Civil Engineering, NIT Silchar
Two (2) years or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier
Rs. 37000/- per month ; HRA @10%, if Institute Accommodation is not provided
Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Silchar, Assam

content_sections.heading: About NIT Silchar and the Project
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Silchar is an Institute of National Importance in Silchar, Assam. The JRF will work in its Department of Civil Engineering under Principal Investigator Dr. Dinesh P. The notice describes the project as follows: it studies the strength and permeability of geothermal rocks under different heat treatments using laboratory tests, and numerical models will be developed to understand heat, fluid flow, rock behaviour, and possible earthquakes caused by water and CO₂ injection.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens only. A B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering with GATE qualification, OR An M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc./M.Sc Tech. degree in Civil, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering, Earth Science, or Geology. GATE/NET-qualified candidates will be given preference. Basic knowledge in geothermal energy. Prior knowledge of geomechanical tests of rock (i.e. Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, fracture toughness and others); knowledge of computational geomechanics such as FEM is advantageous but not mandatory. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 37000/- per month. HRA @10% is paid if Institute accommodation is not provided. The post is temporary, for two years or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Extension of the selected candidate would be based on a performance review every 12 months. The selected candidate shall have to sign an agreement at the time of joining. All terms and conditions for this recruitment will be as per the guidelines of the sponsoring agency (ANRF) and NIT Silchar.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Applications are sent only by email, as a soft copy, to the Principal Investigator. The filled-up application form must be received by 30 November 2026. Duly filled application form (soft copy) with a recent passport size coloured photograph C.V. Soft copies of all supporting documents SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD certificate, if the candidate belongs to one of these categories No objection certificate from the employer, for employed candidates, to be submitted at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates short-listed for the interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode (online/offline), with other details, will be notified through email. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview. No candidate may be recruited if suitable candidates are not found.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Silchar JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: The filled-up application form (soft copy) must be received by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent in Civil, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering with GATE, or an M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc./M.Sc Tech. in Civil, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering, Earth Science, or Geology. GATE/NET-qualified candidates will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years on the last date of advertisement, with relaxation based on experience and qualification and as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Silchar JRF?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 37000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form with your C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents to [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should be used in the application email?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application for the post of JRF under the project - ANRF/ECRG/2024/005933/ENS".

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates may be short-listed on the basis of screening and called for an interview, whose date and mode (online/offline) will be notified through email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIT Silchar JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary post for two years or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, with extension based on a performance review every 12 months.
